verdict.rationale: A patent and trade mark office could plausibly publish official SDKs or client libraries for its search and register services, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only web filing portals (DPMAdirektWeb), downloadable desktop filing software (DPMAdirektPro) and paper filing; none of these is an SDK. The register host's robots.txt disallowing crawling says nothing about developer libraries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
